title: No-Charge Reship for a Cushion That Does Not Fit the Recorded Mask Style — PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Rule.** In the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, when a coverage-billed line shipped a cushion item that does not fit the mask style recorded on the enrollment (a full face cushion, a nasal cushion or nasal pillows other than the one the recorded style uses), Summit Ridge owes the patient a no-charge reship of the fitting cushion item for the style recorded, replacing that line with the replacement reason wrong item. The reship carries the period of the line it replaces: its covered-through date is the replaced line's covered-through date.

## Fitting cushion item by recorded style

| Mask style recorded on the enrollment | Fitting cushion item | Cushion items that do not fit |
|---|---|---|
| full face | full face mask cushion (A7031) | A7032, A7033 |
| nasal | nasal mask cushion (A7032) | A7031, A7033 |
| nasal pillows | nasal pillows pair (A7033) | A7031, A7032 |

The reship bills neither the coverage nor the patient, names the line it replaces, and gives wrong item as the reason.

## Sending the reship — `send_no_charge_replacement_8a217fc0`

**Capability.** `send_no_charge_replacement_8a217fc0` ships a supply item again at no charge to replace one earlier shipment line of the patient's PAP supply enrollment. One call creates one no-charge replacement line dated today that names the line it replaces and why, carries the item and units sent and the last day of use they cover, and bills neither the coverage nor the patient. The replacement then appears in the enrollment's shipment history linked to the replaced line.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `send_no_charge_replacement_8a217fc0` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `resupply_holding_id` | the reference number of the patient's PAP supply enrollment, read from the enrollment lookup before the call | identifier text |
| `original_line_id` | the reference number of the earlier shipment line being replaced, read from the shipment-line lookup before the call | identifier text |
| `replacement_reason` | why the line is replaced | `mask_fit_exchange` (a newly shipped interface or cushion exchanged because it does not fit the patient), `manufacturer_defect` (the item arrived defective), `carrier_lost` (the carrier lost the package and it was never delivered), `wrong_item` (Summit Ridge shipped an item other than the one that fits the patient's recorded equipment); `none` never applies to a replacement and is not accepted |
| `hcpcs_code` | the supply item sent as the replacement | one of A7030 (full face mask), A7031 (full face mask cushion), A7034 (nasal mask or nasal pillows interface), A7032 (nasal mask cushion), A7033 (pair of nasal pillows), A7035 (headgear), A7036 (chinstrap), A7037 (standard tubing), A4604 (heated tubing), A7038 (disposable filter), A7039 (non-disposable filter), A7046 (humidifier water chamber); `none` never applies to an item line and is not accepted |
| `quantity` | the units of the item sent | a non-negative integer |
| `covers_through_date` | the last day of use the replacement covers | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `shipping_method` | how the replacement travels | `ground` (the standard carrier), `expedited` (the faster paid service the patient asked for), `branch_pickup` (the patient collects it at a Summit Ridge branch); `none` never applies to a shipped item and is not accepted |

**Return.** A receipt in which `status` is `replacement_sent` when the line was written; `resupply_line_id` is the reference number of the new replacement line; `original_line_id` echoes the replaced line; `replacement_reason` echoes the reason; `hcpcs_code` and `quantity` echo the item and units sent; `service_from_date` is today's ship date (YYYY-MM-DD); `covers_through_date` echoes the last day covered (YYYY-MM-DD); `billing_basis` is `no_charge`.
